statements.text: The U.S. Trade Representative proposed increasing tariffs on 8507.60.0010 (Lithium-ion batteries of a kind used as the primary source of electrical power for electrically powered vehicles of subheadings 8703.40, 8703.50, 8703.60, 8703.70 or 8703.80) in 2024 and on 8507.60.0020 (Lithium-ion batteries: Other) in 2026.
Lithium-ion Non-electrical Vehicle Batteries HTSUS Subheading Product Description Rate Timing 8507.60.0020 Lithium ion batteries: Other 25% 2026

The U.S. Trade Representative has determined that the requests to remove particular batteries are inconsistent with the President’s direction, which broadly covers all lithium-ion batteries, and are inconsistent with the goals of diversifying supply chains and of reducing our reliance on China in an industry targeted by China for dominance.
Lithium-ion non-electrical vehicle batteries – Increase rate to 25% in 2026
Lithium-ion non-electrical vehicle batteries – Increase rate to 25% in 2026
Lithium-ion electrical vehicle batteries – Increase rate to 25% in 2024

Lithium-ion Batteries: The President directed the U.S. Trade Representative to increase tariffs on lithium-ion batteries to 25 percent, with “lithium-ion electrical vehicle batteries” increasing in 2024 and “lithium-ion non-electrical vehicle batteries” increasing in 2026.
